summary: Tested new certificate validation feature (public /validasi + admin 'Data Sertifikat' tab) end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass covering courses, registrations, admin gating, certificate verify (case-insensitive), create/list/delete, duplicate 400, and auth guards. Frontend: full Playwright flow passes - navbar link -> /validasi, seed cert HRDU/2026/0001 (Budi Santoso) verified in both uppercase and lowercase, not-found state, admin login with Pass123$$, sertifikat tab lists seed, add new cert -> appears in table + publicly verifiable, duplicate submission shows error, delete via window.confirm removes row and cert becomes 404, Data Pendaftar tab still functional.
critical_code_review_comments: CertAdmin uses window.confirm() for delete - acceptable for MVP but a shadcn AlertDialog would be more consistent with the rest of the app.
cert-input-tanggal uses native <input type=date> browser picker instead of shadcn Calendar component; acceptable but inconsistent design language.
Regex escape in verify_certificate uses re.escape which safely handles special chars in nomor like '/'.
server.py has grown to ~270 lines mixing storage/admin/cert routes; consider splitting into routers/ if it grows further.
